notes.title: Free prologue release coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some exciting news to share with you! We are almost ready to release a free prologue for Lord Ambermaze.

It's a turn-based strategy-puzzle game that masterfully combines mysterious labyrinths and gloomy villains, enchanted vegetables and giant insects, and the feeling of a cozy bedtime story all within a dangerous time-bending adventure.

[previewyoutube=1sIAHoWANAw;full][/previewyoutube]

Add the game to your Wishlist! And remember to join our Discord server so you don't miss out on the release of the Lord Ambermaze prologue and stay up-to-date on the latest news.

Regards,
Lord Ambermaze Team
